mapper.sql: id, flow_code, company_id, bank_account, bank_name, trade_time, direction, amount, currency, counter_party, memo, raw_text, extracted, voucher_id, agent_task_id, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_finance_bank_flow ( flow_code, company_id, bank_account, bank_name, trade_time, direction, amount, currency, counter_party, memo, raw_text, extracted, status, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{flowCode}, #{companyId}, #{bankAccount}, #{bankName}, #{tradeTime}, #{direction}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{counterParty}, #{memo}, #{rawText}, #{extracted}, #{status}, #{createBy}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO opc_finance_bank_flow ( flow_code, company_id, bank_account, bank_name, trade_time, direction, amount, currency, counter_party, memo, raw_text, extracted, status, create_by, create_time ) VALUES
(#{item.flowCode}, #{item.companyId}, #{item.bankAccount}, #{item.bankName}, #{item.tradeTime}, #{item.direction}, #{item.amount}, #{item.currency}, #{item.counterParty}, #{item.memo}, #{item.rawText}, #{item.extracted}, #{item.status}, #{item.createBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'IN' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'OUT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS out_total, COUNT(*) AS flow_count, SUM(CASE WHEN extracted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS extracted_count FROM opc_finance_bank_flow WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND trade_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{period},'-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND trade_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{period},'-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
